Interface Gyroscope

All Known Subinterfaces:
BufferedGyroscope
All Known Implementing Classes:
Bmi088, Lsm6ds3, NineAxisMotionShield, PoweredUpGyroscope
public interface Gyroscope
The minimal contract for a gyroscope.

  • Method Summary

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    int
    getAngle()
    Returns the heading in whole degrees, from 0 up to 359, growing clockwise since the last reset().
    float
    getAngularVelocity()
    Returns the angular velocity in degrees per second, clockwise positive: the direction getAngle() grows.
    void
    recalibrateOffset()
    Measures and stores the offset, or bias, that getAngularVelocity() subtracts.
    void
    reset()
    Resets the accumulated getAngle() to zero.

  • Method Details

    • getAngle

      int getAngle()
      Returns the heading in whole degrees, from 0 up to 359, growing clockwise since the last reset().

    • getAngularVelocity

      float getAngularVelocity()
      Returns the angular velocity in degrees per second, clockwise positive: the direction getAngle() grows. The offset from recalibrateOffset() is already removed.

    • recalibrateOffset

      void recalibrateOffset()
      Measures and stores the offset, or bias, that getAngularVelocity() subtracts.

    • reset

      void reset()
      Resets the accumulated getAngle() to zero.
